description:
A 3-winding phase-shifting transformer.

Phase shifts are specified in radians for primary, secondary, and tertiary windings.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

primary_star_arc.description: An Arc defining this transformer `from` a primary bus `to` the star bus.

secondary_star_arc.description: An Arc defining this transformer `from` a secondary bus `to` the star bus.

tertiary_star_arc.description: An Arc defining this transformer `from` a tertiary bus `to` the star bus.

star_bus.description: Star (hidden) Bus that this component (equivalent model) is connected to.

active_power_flow_primary.description: Initial condition of active power flow through the transformer primary side to star (hidden) bus.

reactive_power_flow_primary.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow through the transformer primary side to star (hidden) bus.

active_power_flow_secondary.description: Initial condition of active power flow through the transformer secondary side to star (hidden) bus.

reactive_power_flow_secondary.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow through the transformer secondary side to star (hidden) bus.

active_power_flow_tertiary.description: Initial condition of active power flow through the transformer tertiary side to star (hidden) bus.

reactive_power_flow_tertiary.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow through the transformer tertiary side to star (hidden) bus.

r_primary.description: Equivalent resistance from primary to star (hidden) bus.

x_primary.description: Equivalent reactance from primary to star (hidden) bus.

r_secondary.description: Equivalent resistance from secondary to star (hidden) bus.

x_secondary.description: Equivalent reactance from secondary to star (hidden) bus.

r_tertiary.description: Equivalent resistance from tertiary to star (hidden) bus.

x_tertiary.description: Equivalent reactance from tertiary to star (hidden) bus.

rating.description: Thermal rating. Flow through the transformer must be between -`rating` and `rating`.
rating.descriptor: in psy5 a required param with an option to be nothing

r_12.description: Measured resistance from primary to secondary windings (R1-2 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E).

x_12.description: Measured reactance from primary to secondary windings (X1-2 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E).

r_23.description: Measured resistance from secondary to tertiary windings (R2-3 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E).

x_23.description: Measured reactance from secondary to tertiary windings (X2-3 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E).

r_13.description: Measured resistance from primary to tertiary windings (R1-3 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E).

x_13.description: Measured reactance from primary to tertiary windings (X1-3 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E).

alpha_primary.description: Initial condition of primary phase shift between the `from` and `to` buses.

alpha_secondary.description: Initial condition of secondary phase shift between the `from` and `to` buses.

alpha_tertiary.description: Initial condition of tertiary phase shift between the `from` and `to` buses.

base_power_12.description: Base power for per unitization for primary-secondary windings.

base_power_23.description: Base power for per unitization for secondary-tertiary windings.

base_power_13.description: Base power for per unitization for primary-tertiary windings.

g.description: Shunt conductance from star (hidden) bus to ground (MAG1 in PSS/E).

b.description: Shunt susceptance from star (hidden) bus to ground (MAG2 in PSS/E).

primary_turns_ratio.description: Primary side off-nominal turns ratio with respect to connected primary bus (WINDV1 with CW = 1 in PSS/E).

secondary_turns_ratio.description: Secondary side off-nominal turns ratio with respect to connected secondary bus (WINDV2 with CW = 1 in PSS/E).

tertiary_turns_ratio.description: Tertiary side off-nominal turns ratio with respect to connected tertiary bus (WINDV3 with CW = 1 in PSS/E).

available_primary.description: Status if primary winding is available or not.

available_secondary.description: Status if secondary winding is available or not.

available_tertiary.description: Status if tertiary winding is available or not.

phase_angle_limits.description: Minimum and maximum phase angle limits.

control_objective_primary.description: Control objective for the tap changer for winding 1.

control_objective_secondary.description: Control objective for the tap changer for winding 2.

control_objective_tertiary.description: Control objective for the tap changer for winding 3.

title: PhaseShiftingTransformer3W
